options.orbit: Threshold, then a central void. You pass between two objects and a screen just inside the door, then circle one hero object standing alone in a large empty void ringed by six small objects. Product stations sit at the four outer corners, outside the loop. The pay desk closes the loop at the back. Size: default 20 x 16 m.
options.field: One open low field. A floor strip leads from the door to a single large hero object; four sculptural stations hold the product in a loose ring around it, and the route wanders between them to the pay at the back right. Nothing but the hero is tall. Size: default 16 x 12 m.
options.chamber: A room inside the room. A walled chamber with two side openings stands in the middle; three low monoliths inside it carry the product; two blocks break through the chamber walls. The route enters the chamber, circles the monoliths and leaves. There is no single hero: the chamber is the event. Size: default 18 x 12 m.
options.ritual: A small ritual room. Shelf walls wrap the left, right and back; one object at the centre is where you pause first; a counter sits at the back. The route circles the centre, then follows the shelves. Size: default 12 x 10 m.

reply.title: Threshold of the Rainy Night
reply.subtitle: A sensory immersion into the stillness of a storm-cleansed sanctuary.
reply.line: Step through a narrow aperture into a mirrored chamber where the rhythmic echoes of rain dissolve into the cold, sharp scent of wet stone and earth.
reply.synopsis: As you cross the threshold, the cacophony of the city vanishes, replaced by the soft, ambient glow reflecting off polished concrete surfaces. You navigate between monolithic black stones that hold fragrances atop their damp, porous peaks, grounding you in the heart of the storm. Piercing the infinite mirror walls, raw strata clay elements suggest a world eroding beneath the surface. You finally retreat to the charcoal plinth or the secluded lime plaster alcove, where the lingering scent of rain becomes your own.
reply.quote: In the silence after the rain, the scent of the earth reveals the truth of the moment.

why.meaning: The reflective walls create an illusion of endless space that isolates you from the external environment.
The black stone pedestals elevate the fragrance to eye level, turning the act of smelling into a ritualistic encounter.
The raw clay elements breaking through the walls provide a tactile contrast to the polished, futuristic surfaces.
The charcoal plinth and lime alcove offer a grounded, physical space for you to conclude your sensory journey.
